scale: Five categories, each scored 0-2; total out of 10.

categories.name: Identity and footprint
categories.basis: Mesh bounds independently reopen at [-50, 50] x [-65.5, 65.5] x [-0.15, 10.2006] m and match the reconciled manifest exactly. Major aviation-building forms are present. The roofed additions' exact roof extents remain inferred rather than confirmed by a roof plan.

categories.name: Position and scale
categories.basis: Master contains a linked collection instance at (-1325, -1229.5, 0) m, identity rotation and unit scale. This translation maps the manifest's local XY footprint exactly to the expected world bounds.

categories.name: Roof and levels
categories.basis: Two missing wing tops are now closed with materialed, subtly sloped membrane plates. The four-corner slabs are very simple and their extents were inferred from the existing wall tops; the supplied MSKTD photos show roofed interiors but do not establish an as-built roof plan. The separate glazed sloping roof remains present.

categories.name: Distinctive exterior
categories.basis: The render shows brick wings, curtain-wall glazing, the taller sloped-roof glazed volume and aircraft/hangar elements. The new roof planes read as large uninterrupted generic sheets, and the current evidence is not a direct exterior/roof-plan comparison.

categories.name: Interior, materials, export and evidence
categories.basis: Fresh reopen finds 2,300 objects / 2,214 meshes, a detailed lecture-room and hangar inventory, no mesh without a material, and no external image dependencies. Six project photos and a rendered preview are saved with the asset audit. The new roof pieces use one generic membrane material and remain approximate.
